search.title: ChangXin Memory Technologies
search.snippet: ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) is a Chinese semiconductor integrated device manufacturer headquartered in Hefei, Anhui, specializing in the production of dynamic random-access memory (DRAM).

search.title: Semiconductor industry
search.snippet: The semiconductor industry is the aggregate of companies engaged in the design and fabrication of semiconductor devices.

search.title: Dynamic random-access memory
search.snippet: Dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) is a type of random-access memory that stores each bit of data in a separate capacitor.
